data.name: Scary Game
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

You wake up in a pitch-black, unfamiliar corridor — and your only "weapon" is your curiosity.
In this absurd, dark comedy walking simulator, each door leads you to a strange and unpredictable room. Sometimes it’ll test your nerves, sometimes it’ll trigger your laughter.
You’ll be scared, you’ll laugh... but more than anything, you’ll ask yourself: “How do I get out of here?”

Scary Game offers a short yet unforgettable experience, lasting around 15–25 minutes.
Will you escape, or will you remain the main character of this twisted comedy?

Features

• Horror + Comedy: Jumpscares and unexpected jokes share the same space; fear and humor go hand in hand.
• Pure Walking Sim: No weapons, no combat — progression is all about exploration and reacting to your environment.
• A New Surprise Behind Every Door: You'll never know what awaits on the other side.
• Environmental Storytelling: Objects and wall writings deepen the absurd dark comedy atmosphere.
• Atmospheric Sound Design: A dynamic soundscape filled with eerie noises, voice reactions, and absurd jingles.
• Short but Intense: A compact, punchy experience designed to be completed in 15–25 minutes — and to stay with you long after it ends.

data.short_description: You open your eyes in a dark, unfamiliar room; each door drags you into a new chamber filled with absurd surprises and dark comedy. Will you manage to escape, or will you continue to star in this black comedy?
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains cartoonish nudity presented in a comedic context (e.g. a character with a sausage-shaped body part), exaggerated explosion effects, and occasional depictions of blood and dead bodies. All mature content is intended for dark comedy and parody purposes.
